Mizu Family Pipe Connect

Connect the two friends of the same color and fill the whole board!

Mizu: Connect the two friends of the same color with a line! Fill up the whole board!
★ 40 Stages📅 Daily Puzzle⏱ No Timer
How to play: Drag from a round face tile (an endpoint) and the pipe stretches out. Connect the two friends of the same color and fill every cell on the board to clear the stage! Start dragging from the middle of a pipe to redraw it from there. If you cross another color's pipe, that pipe is cut at that point. There is no timer, so take your time.
